decks.create: INSERT INTO decks (id, name, group_key, status, has_thumb, idempotency_key, error_message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 0, ?, NULL, ?, ?)
decks.list_ready_latest: SELECT * FROM decks WHERE status = 'ready' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
decks.list_all_latest: SELECT * FROM decks ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
decks.update_status: UPDATE decks SET status = ?, error_message = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?
decks.update_thumb: UPDATE decks SET has_thumb = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?
